The '''''Greetbos''''' was a [[GAT-12j]] [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray blastboat]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] to patrol the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] after the invasion of [[Derilyn]].
